Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear impact sustained while turning left in a motor
vehicle. The reported mechanism is consistent with the low back strain diagnosed, and
the force described fits the pattern of soft tissue injury observed on examination.
Imaging and physical findings clearly support the diagnosis. Care totaled 30 visits,
including manual therapy, stretching and strengthening exercises, and graded activity
guidance. Treatment followed a typical progression, with visit frequency tapering as
symptoms and range of motion improved. The patient was also treated for low back
complaints within the past two years, and that earlier condition appears to contribute
to some of the current symptoms. Billing records reflect one charge per service, with
no duplicate entries. At the time of discharge, the patient had reached a stable
functional level and was released to self-directed home exercise with instrucitons to
return if symptoms worsen.
